journey.name: cached profile header while loading
journey.description:
Verifies that opening Profile straight after a relaunch, while the signed-in profile is still loading, shows the cached name read-only. The edit, copy, share, QR code and tag controls are absent. The full profile then replaces the cached header in place.
Precondition: an onboarded E2E Bitkit build with Paykit UI enabled and a Bitkit-generated Pubky identity whose profile has a name. Profile must have loaded fully once on this build, so the cache records which key the name belongs to. Use the test simulator UDID for <UDID>.
iOS-only, with no Android counterpart. Android shows a spinner until the profile loads. A warm network can finish the load before the first snapshot, so an "already loaded" result repeats the relaunch once instead of failing. See README.md.

actions.action: Wait for the full profile name (id "ProfileViewName", predicate exists) and note the name it shows
If the PIN screen appears, unlock the wallet
As soon as the home screen shows, tap the header profile button (id "ProfileButton")

If a bare spinner with no "Profile" title shows first, wait for it to clear. That is the Pubky initialization wait, which has to finish before the cached header can show. A spinner under the "Profile" title with no name is not that wait: no cached header showed, so report it

Verify the cached profile header (id "ProfileCachedHeader") is visible and its name (id "ProfileCachedName") matches the name noted before the relaunch. If the full profile name (id "ProfileViewName") is already showing, the load finished first: report "already loaded" and repeat from the terminate step once rather than failing
Verify the cached header is read-only: edit (id "ProfileEdit"), copy (id "ProfileCopy"), share (id "ProfileShare"), the QR code (id "ProfileQRCode") and add tag (id "ProfileAddTag") are all absent
Wait for the full profile name (id "ProfileViewName", predicate exists)
Verify the cached profile header (id "ProfileCachedHeader") is gone and the full profile name (id "ProfileViewName") matches the cached name
Verify edit (id "ProfileEdit") and the QR code (id "ProfileQRCode") are visible
